title: Kunze kwekukanganisa kwechirevo
description: Kukurukurirana uku kwave kusvika pa AI inogumira ndangariro, kunge bhodhi chena richizadza. Isu tinokwanisa kuwedzera hwindo rekurangarira (rinonzi saizi yemukati) kuti irangarire zvakawanda, asi inogona kushandisa yakawanda yekurangarira komputa yako. Isu tinokwanisa zvakare kudzikisa mapindiro, zvinoreva kuti ichakanganwa imwe yenhoroondo yekutaura kuti iwane nzvimbo yemeseji mitsva.
lastRequestOverflowed: Chikumbiro chekupedzisira chakapfachukira pahwindo rezviri mukati.
contextOverflowDetail: Ichi chikumbiro chinoda ma tokens {{request}}, asi hwindo remumodhi rinobata chete {{context}}.
emptyReply: Modhi yakapera isina kudzosera mhinduro. Edza kugadzira patsva, kana tarisa marongero evanopa.

engine.MODEL_ARCH_NOT_SUPPORTED: Kuvaka kwemuenzaniso uyu hakutsigirwe neinjini iripo. Kugadziridza injini kubva kuZvirongwa kunogona kuwedzera rutsigiro.
engine.MODEL_LOAD_TIMED_OUT: Iyo modhi yakatora nguva yakareba kurodha uye yakamiswa. Modhi diki kana saizi diki yechirevo kazhinji inobatsira.
engine.MISSING_SHARED_LIBRARY: Raibhurari iyo injini inoda haipo, saka haigone kutanga.
engine.GPU_DRIVER_TOO_OLD: GPU mutyairi wako anyanya kuchemera injini iyi. Kugadziridza mutyairi, kana kuchinja injini ye CPU mumaSettings, zvinogadzirisa izvi.
engine.OUT_OF_MEMORY: Iko hakuna ndangariro yakakwana yekumhanyisa modhi iyi. Modhi diki kana saizi diki yechirevo kazhinji inobatsira.
engine.IO_ERROR: Faera harina kukwanisa kuverengwa kana kunyorwa uchitanga modhi.
engine.INTERNAL_ERROR: Pane chakaipa mukati meNovera tichitanga modhi.
engine.ENGINE_UNREACHABLE: Injini ye llama.cpp iri kushanda, asi Novera haikwanisi kubatana nayo pakombiyuta iyi (127.0.0.1). A VPN, proxy kana chengetedzo software inogona kunge iri kuvharisa majokoni emunharaunda.
engine.ENGINE_STOPPED: Iyo llama.cpp injini yakamira ndisingafungire. Kutumira meseji zvakare kunotanga zvakare; ikaramba yakamira, chengetedzo software kana GPU mutyairi anogona kunge ari honzeri.
engine.UNSUPPORTED_CPU: Mamodheru emuno haashandiswe paprocessor yekombuta iyi. Novera's injini yemuno yakavakirwa Apple Silicon Macs (M1 kana nyowani), saka haikwanise kutanga paIntel Mac. Cloud uye tsika vanopa vachiri kushanda.

serverPortOccupiedDescription: Port {{port}} yave kutoshandiswa. Ndapota edza imwe chiteshi.
